publicProfile.title: Public profile
publicProfile.description: Others can view your profile and follow you

showPlaylists.title: Show playlists
showPlaylists.description: Others can see your public playlists on your profile

adaptiveTheme.title: Adaptive Theme Color
adaptiveTheme.description: Dynamically match the primary color to the current album art.

customColor.title: Custom Color
customColor.description: Customize the primary color of the active theme.

visualizerStyle.title: Visualizer Style
visualizerStyle.description: Choose the appearance of the audio visualizer.

spatialAudio.title: 8D Spatial Audio
spatialAudio.description: Creates a 3D immersive experience by moving the sound around your head.

stereoWidener.title: Ultra-Wide Stereo
stereoWidener.description: Expands the stereo soundstage far beyond your headphones.

bassBoost.title: Super Bass (Sub-Bass)
bassBoost.description: Adds deep, punchy sub-bass boost and warm analog harmonic weight.

slowedReverb.title: Slowed + Reverb
slowedReverb.description: Slows playback to 0.85x with deep pitch and lush hall reverberation.

nightcore.title: Nightcore Mode
nightcore.description: Speeds up playback to 1.25x with raised pitch for an energetic anime vibe.

speed.title: Playback Speed
speed.description: Adjust the playback tempo from 0.5x to 2.0x.

reverb.title: Acoustic Environment (Reverb)
reverb.description: Simulates listening to music in real spaces and venues.

eq.title: Equalizer
eq.description: Adjust the 10-band audio equalizer to your liking.

info.title: Information
info.description: About the application and useful keyboard shortcuts.
info.shortcutsNote: Global shortcuts work even when the app is in the background.
